messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — v0.23 cutoff in ~12h (09:00 UTC branch freeze). Please confirm: version bump PR, changelog entries, QA smoke owner, and security checklist. Tagging owners @Sam @Jin @Priya @Alex. Blockers?
Sam: On it. Preparing version bump PR (will include changelog stub). Pushing within 30m. PR: #3123
Sam: Bump script I'm using:
```bash
git checkout release/v0.23
git pull origin release/v0.23
git merge --no-ff feature/opt-batching
./scripts/bump_version.sh 0.23.0
```
Jin: Docs updates ready. Added migration note for kv-cache config. Will add example snippet after Sam's PR lands. No blocker.
Priya (QA): I can own the smoke/canary run tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Need changelog entry with migration steps + any opt-in flags. Also: please tag the canary build with `canary-v0.23`.
Alex: Security: running SCA + secret-scan on the PR diff. Sec bot will post results here. If anything shows up we'll triage ASAP.
sec-bot: SCA scan queued for PR #3123 -> results: 2 low-severity advisory(s) in dependency 'lib-foo'. No secrets detected.
Sam: updated PR #3123 with changelog stub and migration note. Also added `canary` tag on the build. CI is green except flaky test `test/integration/cache_timeout`.
Priya (QA): Noted flaky test. I'll run the smoke with retries. If it keeps failing, I'll open a flaky-test ticket and ping @eng-sre.
deploy-bot: Canary build deployed -> canary-v0.23 at infra-us-east-2. Health: OK. 2/2 checks passed.
Maya: Thanks — if no further blockers I'll merge bump ~30m before freeze so releases team can cut. I'll be on watch during cutover. :thumbsup:
